items.observed_on_walk: The search box focused and empty opens no list.

items.observed_on_walk: Options are still account registrations with raw type codes ('S1', 'IRA') and a masked tail.
items.acceptance: Each option names a client in client language; a client with several registrations appears once; no raw type code in the option.

items.observed_on_walk: Each option carries the firm TOKEN ('cottonwood', '49financial'), not its display name; the row layout is now uniform.

items.observed_on_walk: The empty-state line reads 'Choose a client to see its firm and accounts.'

items.acceptance: A full-name query in either order ('anna thiessen', 'thiessen anna') puts the exact client first. The CTO rules whether ranking is server-side (IRPT_BCKEND directory search) or client-side.

items.observed_on_walk: No option is covered; the occlusion check found 0.
